clauses.clause: Spectacle: ≥ 2 HMGs fire, tank enters at +22 s and fires every 8–12 s (never within 15 m of player/ally), never through the barrier wall; helicopter orbits and withdraws.
clauses.note: Both tiers:2 actual HMG sources; tank enters tick3289, exactly22s after turn1969. Fresh mortal routes14 shots/tier, ordinary inter-shot intervals8.0167–11.7333s; every actual impact including forced truck shell clears living player/registered allies by≥15.1449m low/15.3692m high. Actual helicopter orbit unwrapped angle spans>42radians and withdraws. Full renderer16/15 shot segments intersect no concrete/wire barrier triangles; positive across-wall controls do hit. Three shots contact decorative sign planes above the concrete crest; recorded explicitly, not mislabelled concrete wall impacts. No game changes. Protected courier only in supplementary renderer route; ordinary native clearance is mortal.
